title: T. P. Buford — grocery and confectionery advertisement
text:
T. P. BUFORD.

About fifteen years ago, T. P. Buford opened up a little stock of groceries and confectioneries in a frame building on Water street. His character was already established and it did not take long to establish a nice paying trade. As his customers increased, he increased his stock and when the other merchants moved into brick houses, he soon followed. His goods are pure and can be relied on as the best on the market.
